source_snapshot.procedure: Run fio on all drives with time_based, runtime=43200, bs=4K, rw=randrw, numjobs=32 depending on CPU design, size=4g and iodepth=32; then collect results/photos and unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: System works after fio, system logs have no error, and IOPS is at least 80% of the theoretical specification value
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek replaces the source with a single-target 60-second, 512-byte, 1-GiB fio job and a fixed 70% read mix.

original_test_intent.purpose: Stress every SSD in the owner-defined drive population with the source's 12-hour 4-KiB random mixed read/write fio profile, then verify each drive's performance/health and overall system stability against the approved specification.
original_test_intent.target: All physical SSD identities required by the exact SUT storage recipe, mapped through their controller/namespace/logical presentation to dedicated disposable test ranges or files; not one convenient mounted volume or the OS/system disk.
original_test_intent.scope: For every required drive: `time_based`, `runtime=43200`, `bs=4K`, `rw=randrw`, `numjobs=32` unless the owner resolves a CPU-design-specific value, `size=4g`, and `iodepth=32`, using a qualified job layout/schedule and complete per-drive output. No shorter or different block-size/mix profile is equivalent.
original_test_intent.operation: Freeze the exact drive-to-target matrix and data-loss boundary, validate the source-matching fio job and concurrency/clone address layout offline, obtain destructive-write approval, preserve health/log baselines, run the approved schedule for the full 43,200 seconds per target with continuous monitoring and aborts, then collect per-drive fio/health/error results and verify host recovery.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: Twelve hours (`43200` seconds, matching 720 machine minutes) for every required drive under the approved simultaneous or sequential schedule. `numjobs=32` means 32 independent clones unless the CPU-specific owner value is documented; it is not a 32-run campaign count.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every required drive completes its full-duration profile without fio/media/controller/kernel/platform error, remains healthy, the system remains manageable, and the owner-defined per-drive or aggregate IOPS metric meets at least 80% of the exact comparable theoretical/specification reference.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Complete drive/namespace/controller stable-identity matrix and protected-device exclusions, job file/hash/fio version and resolved clone/address/schedule/mix/ioengine/direct semantics, destructive approval, per-drive full-runtime JSON/output, IOPS/BW/latency/error and utilization, SMART/NVMe/controller/thermal/power/log deltas, threshold calculation/reference and post-test system/drive health.
ambiguities: The source does not define physical-drive versus namespace/logical-volume targeting, simultaneous versus sequential execution, file versus raw-device mode, per-clone address ranges, ioengine/direct mode or read/write mix.
`numjobs=32 (Depends on CPU design)` has no resolution rule, and fio `size=4g` applies per job thread according to official fio semantics.
The 80% theoretical value lacks a document, comparable profile, units and per-drive-versus-aggregate decision.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly restores 43,200 seconds, 4-KiB randrw and 4-GiB source parameters, rejects DeepSeek's non-equivalent 60-second profile and adds destructive target/threshold approval. It reduces the explicit all-drive source scope to one designated SSD test volume and does not resolve numjobs/size clone semantics or per-drive evidence.

applicable_history.decision: The historical review identifies this as a destructive physical-storage stress and requires operator approval; it does not authorize the shortened DeepSeek job.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Classification remains REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, but V2's singular target is a material scope reduction. V3 restores all-drive coverage and requires explicit drive mapping, clone address semantics, schedule and comparable 80% threshold before destructive launch.

available_now: The source fixes all-drive coverage, 12 hours, 4-KiB randrw, size 4 GiB, iodepth 32 and nominal numjobs 32.
Official fio documentation defines `time_based` as looping for the full runtime, `numjobs` as independent cloned jobs and `size` as total file I/O size for each job thread.
Read-only device/mount/controller/health/topology inventory and job-file validation can be completed before any write.

Approved private script or reviewed source-matching fio job with fio version, ioengine/direct/rwmix, filename/file mode, per-clone offsets/files, numjobs CPU-design rule, group/per-drive reporting and simultaneous/sequential schedule

execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The storage/platform owner supplies the target matrix, job semantics and performance reference; the data/service owner approves destruction/backup/window; the lab owner supplies monitoring, thermal/power and recovery coverage.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Enumerate all block devices, namespaces, stable IDs, controller topology, mounts, swap, RAID/LVM/device-mapper and boot/root dependencies; preserve SMART/NVMe/controller/host/BMC baselines without clearing logs
Inspect fio version and hash/review the private job file offline; use parse/dry-run support where safe to confirm targets, clones and ranges without opening writable targets
prohibited_until_closed: Do not start fio, create/truncate a target file on an unapproved filesystem, open any block device writable or assume one volume represents all drives

Do not shorten runtime, change 4K/randrw/size/iodepth/approved numjobs, invent a 70% mix, let clones overlap unintentionally, write evidence onto a stressed target, clear logs or compute PASS from an unmatched theoretical number
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: A two-person stable-ID and range review proves every required drive is covered and every protected device excluded; rendered fio targets/clones/schedule exactly match the signed job; write amplification/endurance and thermal capacity are approved; the 80% reference is profile-matched; abort/recovery/evidence paths are tested.

revision_candidate.purpose: Run the approved source-matching fio workload for twelve hours on every required SSD and verify per-drive performance, media/controller health, system stability and the owner-defined 80% specification threshold.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server storage topology with every required SSD mapped by stable identity to a disposable approved test target, protected system/data devices excluded, qualified fio build/job, stable cooling/power and continuous storage/platform monitoring.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All owner-listed SSDs, with each physical drive/namespace/logical target relationship explicit. Do not reduce to one volume or infer physical coverage through RAID/LVM without an approved mapping.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Stable drive/controller/namespace matrix; disposable per-drive targets/ranges; protected-device exclusions; exact fio build and reviewed job; 43,200 s, 4K, randrw, 4g, iodepth 32 and resolved CPU-specific numjobs; file/raw, mix, engine/direct, clone offsets and schedule; comparable IOPS reference; destructive approval; monitoring/abort/recovery/evidence plan.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve inventory/health/log baselines, render and peer-review the complete drive-to-fio-job map, pause for final destructive approval, run the exact approved simultaneous or sequential schedule so every target receives its full 43,200-second profile, capture per-drive structured output and continuous health/thermal/controller evidence, abort only under defined thresholds, and verify every drive plus the SUT after completion.
revision_candidate.preconditions: All targets and ranges two-person verified; no OS/boot/swap/RAID/LVM/valuable mount dependency; backups and data-loss/endurance approval; source parameters and clone layout validated; fio/tool/evidence hash; matched threshold; maintenance isolation; cooling/power/OOB and recovery ready; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed target/protected-device matrix; job file/hash and fio/version; rendered per-drive filenames/ranges/clones; exact start/end/runtime per target; complete JSON/stdout/stderr; per-drive IOPS/BW/latency/errors; matched 80% calculation; SMART/NVMe/controller/thermal/power/kernel/BMC deltas; abort/recovery events; final drive/system health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact SSD/platform performance specification and approved fio profile with matching block size, read/write mix, queue depth, jobs, cache/direct mode, capacity/range, topology and metric aggregation, plus storage-health/error limits.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never write an unverified or protected target, reduce all-drive scope, mutate source duration/block/mix/depth/size/jobs without owner revision, overlap ranges unintentionally, store sole evidence on tested media, clear logs or declare PASS from incomplete targets or unmatched theory.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Storage/data/platform owners approve every stable target/range, data loss/endurance, exact job and threshold; final confirmation is required after rendered-target review and immediately before launch. End user judges performance and anomalies.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Owners resolve physical/logical mapping, destructive boundary, numjobs CPU rule and theoretical reference. Once approved, launch, monitoring, structured collection and safe abort can be automated; reimage/recovery remains owner-controlled.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong target, fio/media/controller error, thermal/power breach, host/management instability or evidence loss, stop affected/all jobs per the approved policy, preserve outputs and device state, avoid automatic rerun, restore/reimage only allowlisted test targets and quarantine degraded media/controllers until owner disposition.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any identity/range/protected-device ambiguity, unresolved clone overlap or threshold, missing approval/backup/monitoring, target mismatch, fio error, media/SMART/NVMe/controller/kernel fault, unsafe thermal/power, host/OOB instability, incomplete per-drive coverage/evidence or recovery failure.

identified_defects: V2 reduces the source's explicit all-drive scope to a singular designated SSD test volume.
DeepSeek changes 43,200 seconds to 60, 4K to 512 bytes, 4 GiB to 1 GiB and adds a 70% read mix, producing a non-equivalent test.
The source/V2 omit critical fio clone/address and `size=4g` per-thread semantics plus the per-drive/aggregate 80% reference rule.
reason_for_change: Restore all-drive coverage and make the 32-clone/4-GiB address model, destructive target ranges and comparable per-drive performance evidence explicit so a technically valid but narrower one-volume run cannot be declared complete.

new_technical_evidence.title: fio HOWTO
new_technical_evidence.version: upstream master accessed 2026-10-13; installed fio version must be recorded
new_technical_evidence.applicability: The exact installed fio build after option verification
new_technical_evidence.supports: `numjobs` creates independent job clones; `size` is the total file I/O size for each job thread; `time_based` loops the workload for the specified runtime; `randrw` is random mixed reads and writes.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The source does not define target type, clone file/offset mapping, mix ratio, ioengine/direct mode, schedule or CPU-specific numjobs rule.

removed_ambiguities: Restores all required drives and requires stable per-drive coverage evidence.
Defines runtime and fio size/job semantics without inventing the unresolved address layout.
Makes the 80% reference explicitly profile-matched and owner-resolved per drive or aggregate.
resolved_blockers: No permanent capability blocker exists; target/job/spec/approval are provisionable inputs for a technically automatable workload.
remaining_blockers: No fio write until every drive/range, clone layout, schedule, source-matching job, matched 80% reference, destructive approval and recovery are closed.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 corrects V2's material one-drive scope reduction, uses upstream fio semantics to expose clone/size risks, and requires complete per-drive runtime/performance/health evidence while preserving all destructive approval, monitoring and no-shortcut controls.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator retained the source-matching 4K mixed fio profile for 43,200 seconds on every signed SSD and the per-drive 80-percent comparison and destructive range controls.
